comment: ATSC A/53 8VSB trellis code, one of the 12 interleaved encoders: input (X2, X1); X2 precoded (Z2 = X2 xor the last Z2), X1 through the 4-state rate 1/2 code (Z1 = X1, Z0 = s1; s1' = X1 xor s2, s2' = s1). State = (last Z2, s1, s2); the symbol is level 2(4 Z2 + 2 Z1 + Z0) - 7. Decoded on the amplitudes
